body:
N-34 DESIGN, part 4b: tests first, what is not proven, stop-gaps, rejected.
TESTS FIRST: slice 1 table over the recorded hits (Comfortably Numb: The Wall beats two best-ofs, four lives and the 413 s cut rejected; Fade Into You edit rejected by length; Hotel California remaster same; Weird Fishes covers rejected); tolerance at 3000/3001 ms; Arabic/Cyrillic = unsupported; ROW 'two different Arabic songs and ONE Deezer hit: neither gets an album, neither stamped, nothing stored as a miss' in slices 1, 2, 3, 5 (and in refile); 'Habibi' + two different Arabic words; Bjork and Beyonce asked, the slashed L not; unknown record_type never wins; ep beats single, album beats an earlier single; track list without the hit's id = miss; the routes still ask interactive; network guard; mutation-checked. Slice 2: facts table, taken id = HELD writes nothing, outage stores nothing, none asked again after 7 days and on a revision bump, channel/unknown never asked, phones told, migration on a populated database. Slice 3: keeper rig (album known: path, tags, picture; catalogue down: Singles as today; resting gate: short wait; another ref's file never handed over). Slice 5: journal cut at every state and resumed; scan between swap and deletion attaches nothing; playing song skipped; no tags = no move; move_file keeps song_file.id/added_at; undo; shrink-guard count; schema tests. Must stay green: test_cover_finder, test_keeper, test_scanner, test_ref_merge, test_refs, test_catalogue_finders_on_gate.
NOT PROVEN HERE (and what closes each): music-server id and album list across retag or move (slice 4); the real spread of file length minus catalogue length (dry run; 3 s is a default); record_type spellings beyond album/ep (step 0); whether one cover.jpg in Singles/ is the picture of every single there (slice 4); how many of the 650 are non-Latin or channel songs and whether the empty key already merged some (dry run, P2-25's repair); whether both Creatures sit in a playlist together (read before slice 6); the phone half after a repair (emulator check).
STOP-GAPS (price, end): HELD pairs (above); 3 s tolerance (misses, never wrong ids; ends with the dry run); a feature on someone else's album is a miss (B-118 family; ends with P2-12b credits); non-Latin skipped (ends with P2-25, a hard need); one-time re-download (ends with an audio-only key, decision 2); a title search can miss what the catalogue has (a later pass asks the artist's discography once P2-12 slice 3 identified the library artist).
REJECTED: hiding the bucket row; filling ref.album only; retag in place without a move; a work item per file; repair at server start; deleting the old file at once; matching on artist + title only; taking the first hit; asking from the phone (ADR-R38).
